sectors.name: Technology

Government digitalization initiatives and fintech adoption are accelerating, creating durable tailwinds for Indonesian tech infrastructure and payment companies.
sectors.ai: Buy Indonesian tech exposure now: the sector's +1.85% local outperformance and ALERT signal confirm strong momentum, led by global chip and e-commerce names. Rotate into IRSX and PMUI for leveraged ID upside, while holding MSKY for domestic resilience. Fade US laggards like AMZN; prioritize Asian semiconductor and platform leaders.

sectors.name: Mining & Energy
themes: Indonesia's downstream processing mandate (smelter build-out) structurally re-rates nickel and tin producers by capturing more value domestically and tightening global refined supply.
EV battery supply chain re-stocking, led by China's stimulus and US IRA-linked sourcing, sustains demand for Indonesian nickel and tin, making these commodities less cyclical than historical norms.
Regulatory overhang from mining quota (RKAB) delays and environmental audits creates recurring volatility, favoring operators with secured permits and integrated smelting capacity over junior miners.
sectors.ai: Buy selective nickel and tin names (INCO, TINS) on Indonesia's downstream ban stickiness and global EV/battery restocking; avoid chasing ALKA/FPNI one-day spikes as they lack earnings backing. Trim US-exposed coal plays on soft thermal demand. Position for Q3 export quota approvals and smelter commissioning news, which will drive the next leg.

Formal retail channel expansion in tier-2/3 cities is accelerating, benefiting mid-cap staples UNIC and GZCO over the next 12 months.
sectors.ai: Buy consumer staples selectively on IDX strength: IATA, SGRO, and AGAR show momentum from rural demand and palm-oil-linked FMCG input leverage. Rotate out of US-exposed names (INDR, BACH) as IDR strength and domestic consumption hold. Target UNIC and OPMS for defensive yield; trim GZCO on valuation risk.

themes: US regulatory tailwinds and institutional adoption are structurally lifting US-linked crypto assets, creating a durable premium over global peers.

Indonesia's crypto tax framework and growing local exchange liquidity are making digital assets a viable hedge against rupiah depreciation, though adoption remains early-stage.
sectors.ai: Rotate into US-linked and meme-driven digital assets (US +27%, M +16.5%) while trimming laggards like OKB and JST; the WATCH signal suggests consolidation, so take profits on BEAT and PUMP into strength. For Indonesia exposure, prioritize tokens with local exchange listings and remittance use cases, as regulatory clarity is improving but retail sentiment remains fragile.
